meta.name: content-planner
meta.description: GSC-driven content calendar. Pulls real Search Console data, finds the highest click-potential opportunities (striking-distance queries at positions 5-20, unanswered query intent, related-keyword expansions), and produces a dated, prioritized content calendar — ready to hand to /content-writer. Use when the user asks "plan my content", "what should I write next", "content calendar", "content plan", "content roadmap", "editorial calendar", "what topics will rank", "find quick-win SEO topics", "click-potential analysis", or "schedule my SEO content".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据搜索数据生成优先内容日历
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用搜索数据决定下一篇写什么能获得最多点击。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a prioritized content calendar from search data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decide what to write next based on search data for maximum clicks.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会连接你的 Google Search Console 账号，拉取过去 90 天的搜索数据，找出排名在 5-20 位、有提升点击潜力的话题，并生成一份带日期的内容日历，告诉你每周该写什么、为什么写。
howto.when: 当你要求“规划内容”、“下一步写什么”、“内容日历”、“找 SEO 快速见效话题”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划下个月的内容日历。
say.note: Claude 会拉取 GSC 数据并生成日历。

say.text: 根据我的搜索数据，找出点击潜力最高的 5 个话题。
say.note: Claude 会筛选出排名 5-20 位、点击潜力大的查询。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude connects to your Google Search Console, pulls the last 90 days of search data, identifies queries ranking 5-20 with high click potential, and produces a dated, prioritized content calendar with weekly topics and rationale.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for "content plan", "what to write next", "content calendar", "find quick-win SEO topics", or similar requests.

say_en.text: Plan my content calendar for next month.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch GSC data and generate a calendar.

say_en.text: Find the top 5 topics with highest click potential from my search data.
say_en.note: Claude will filter for striking-distance queries with high click potential.
